Qoder.seo_intro:
Qoder，面向真实工作的智能体平台。QoderWork 通过多智能体协同，与办公工具和数据深度连接。
让 AI 围绕真实业务持续完成理解、规划、执行、验证与交付，覆盖法律、金融、营销、HR、咨询等专业场景。
让每个人成为超级个体。
Qoder.seo_intro_en: Qoder, Agentic Platform for Real Work。Qoder enables AI to understand, plan, execute, and iterate on real-world tasks through multi-agent collaboration, long-horizon execution, memory, and deep codebase integration—until delivery is complete.
